title: IPU documents on a crash that killed Sandia technicians

tellings.quote: IPU documents later because that actually talks about like a crash retrieval um that killed technicians at Sandia National Labs because of the danger of the crash.

plain: A set of papers called the IPU documents is said to describe the recovery of a crashed craft, sometime between 1947 and 1949, that was so dangerous it killed technicians from Sandia National Labs, a US nuclear weapons laboratory in New Mexico. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb raises this on the show, linking the papers to what he calls the Majestic documents, said to come from a secret group that handled crashed craft, and promises to come back to them later without naming where they come from. If true, it would mean the government recovered crashed objects in the early years and that this work cost lives.
